name: MLX Orphaned Cart for WooCommerce
author: modulux

sections.description:
MLX Orphaned Cart is a high‑performance recovery solution built for WooCommerce store owners who want speed without unnecessary overhead. Its lightweight architecture uses native WordPress processes and the WooCommerce Action Scheduler to handle tracking efficiently, keeping your store responsive while delivering reliable cart recovery.

We believe in being a “good guest” on your server. That’s why we’ve built in advanced database hygiene tools and a strict “Clean Uninstall” policy.

Key Features

  • Intelligent Tracking: Captures carts for logged-in users and guest shoppers.
  • Sync on Login: Automatically links guest carts to user accounts if they log in later.
  • Background Processing: Zero impact on site speed thanks to Action Scheduler batching.
  • Privacy First: One-click unsubscribe links and secure email blacklisting.
  • Custom Cleanup: Set an automatic 30-day “expiry” for anonymous guest data.
  • Complete Control: A dedicated setting to wipe all plugin data, tables, and settings if you choose to uninstall.
  • ROI Analytics: Real-time dashboard stats showing exactly how many emails were sent, how many carts were recovered, and the total revenue earned.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mlx-orphaned-cart-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Head over to MLX Carts > Settings to set your schedule and craft your recovery email.
  4. Pro Tip: Check the “Data Cleanup” box in settings if you want a 100% clean break if you ever delete the plugin.
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my checkout page?

Not at all. The plugin hooks into WooCommerce’s native cart actions and processes emails in the background. Your customers won’t feel a thing.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

By default, your recovery data stays safe in case you want to reinstall. However, if you check the “Delete on Uninstall” box in our settings, we will completely scrub our custom tables and settings from your database the moment you hit “Delete.”

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. We include unsubscribe tokens in every mail and provide tools to auto-delete guest data that hasn’t been claimed within 30 days.
